# newsdesk-mcp

> Self-hosted MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for a Raspberry Pi that turns a ChatGPT Scheduled
> Task into a curated, non-repetitive daily news briefing posted to a Discord channel by a bot.

ChatGPT researches the news from an allowlist of outlets; the server keeps a compact long-term
memory and tells ChatGPT whether each candidate story is new, a duplicate, or an update of an earlier
story, then delivers posts to Discord reliably. No LLM runs on the Pi. Python, SQLite, systemd,
OAuth 2.1, Streamable HTTP. MIT license.

Use it when you want: an AI news digest in Discord that never repeats stories; follow-up posts only
for material developments; only trusted sources; unattended operation on a Raspberry Pi.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Oniichan187/newsdesk-mcp/blob/main/README.md): overview, comparison, quick start, FAQ
- [Architecture](https://github.com/Oniichan187/newsdesk-mcp/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): run lifecycle, dedup memory, outbox state machine
- [ChatGPT setup](https://github.com/Oniichan187/newsdesk-mcp/blob/main/docs/CHATGPT_SETUP.md): connecting the MCP server as a ChatGPT app, OAuth, limitations
- [Scheduled Task prompt](https://github.com/Oniichan187/newsdesk-mcp/blob/main/docs/SCHEDULED_TASK_PROMPT.md): ready-to-paste prompt
- [Customizing](https://github.com/Oniichan187/newsdesk-mcp/blob/main/docs/CUSTOMIZING.md): sources allowlist, language, country, Discord settings
- [Security](https://github.com/Oniichan187/newsdesk-mcp/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): exposure, secrets, threat model

## MCP tools

- newsrelay_begin_run (read-only): research time window for a run
- newsrelay_match_candidates (read-only): duplicate / update / new classification against memory
- newsrelay_publish_digest (write): publish NEW / UPDATE / CORRECTION stories to Discord
- newsrelay_complete_noop (write): finish a run with nothing to post
- newsrelay_publish_status, newsrelay_health (read-only)
